```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3.2, fig.align = "center", out.width = "80%"
)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load-data}
wildlife <- read_rds("../data/wildlife_clean.rds")
```

## Damage rate by phase of flight

```{r phase}
phase_rates <- wildlife %>%
  filter(!is.na(phase)) %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), rate = mean(damaged == "Yes"))

phase_rates

ggplot(phase_rates, aes(x = phase, y = rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Climb and descent have the highest damage rates",
    x = "Phase of flight", y = "Strikes with damage"
  )
```

## Damage rate by height at impact

```{r height}
height_rates <- wildlife %>%
  filter(!is.na(height_bin)) %>%
  group_by(height_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), rate = mean(damaged == "Yes"))

height_rates

ggplot(height_rates, aes(x = height_bin, y = rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Strikes higher up are more likely to cause damage",
    x = "Height at impact", y = "Strikes with damage"
  )
```

## Damage rate by speed at impact

```{r speed}
speed_rates <- wildlife %>%
  filter(!is.na(speed)) %>%
  mutate(speed_bin = cut(
    speed,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 120, 140, 160, 200, Inf),
    labels = c("120 or less", "121-140", "141-160", "161-200", "Over 200")
  )) %>%
  group_by(speed_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), rate = mean(damaged == "Yes"))

speed_rates

ggplot(speed_rates, aes(x = speed_bin, y = rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Faster strikes are more likely to cause damage",
    x = "Speed at impact (knots)", y = "Strikes with damage"
  )
```

## Height and speed together

```{r height-speed}
wildlife %>%
  filter(!is.na(height), !is.na(speed)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = height, color = damaged)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No" = "gray70", "Yes" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "Planes that are higher up are also flying faster",
    x = "Speed at impact (knots)", y = "Height at impact (feet)",
    color = "Damaged"
  )

wildlife %>%
  filter(!is.na(height), !is.na(speed)) %>%
  summarise(correlation = cor(height, speed))
```

## Bird size

```{r bird-size}
size_rates <- wildlife %>%
  filter(!is.na(bird_size)) %>%
  group_by(bird_size) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), rate = mean(damaged == "Yes"))

size_rates

ggplot(size_rates, aes(x = bird_size, y = rate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Large birds are much more likely to cause damage",
    subtitle = "Only strikes where the bird was recorded as unknown small, medium, or large",
    x = "Bird size", y = "Strikes with damage"
  )
```

## Reporting over time

```{r years, fig.height = 4.5}
year_summary <- wildlife %>%
  group_by(incident_year) %>%
  summarise(reports = n(), rate = mean(damaged == "Yes"))

year_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(c(reports, rate), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(measure = if_else(measure == "reports", "Number of reports", "Share with damage")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = incident_year, y = value)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "More reports over time, but a smaller share with damage",
    x = "Year", y = NULL
  )
```
